SUBPROBLEM=Prove cleanup/ownership semantics and safe rejection/downshift behavior for a Gen5 opening-only 120Hz vote; define physical Fold7 verification matrix.
CURRENT_MECHANISM=Current View-backed SnapshotSurface overlay has no refresh vote; opening attempt ownership already exists in Fold7Gen3VisualCoordinator/PanelEngine.

DESIGN_SUMMARY=Use an attempt-scoped visual lease keyed by serviceEpoch/openingAttemptId/visualGeneration/host. For current View window, set preferredRefreshRate=120 before addView and clear to 0 on current-attempt end; API34+ defines this as DEFAULT + ONLY_IF_SEAMLESS. If final Gen5 owns a mutable SurfaceControl, use one setFrameRate(DEFAULT, ONLY_IF_SEAMLESS) and clearFrameRate instead of stacking votes. Drive visual prediction from actual Choreographer VsyncCallback preferred FrameTimeline expected-presentation timestamps so rejection or 120->60 downshift is naturally safe. Never retry-spam.
INVARIANTS=visual-only; no semantic/panel/wake/handoff authority; no CHANGE_FRAME_RATE_ALWAYS; no closing-path vote; request once; current-owner-only clear; 60Hz is valid fallback; mode label/API return not proof.

Matrix includes normal 120, rejected 60, stalls, thermal downshift, close-reopen, 30-70 oscillation, timeout, remap, service/Shizuku death, black-cover classification, wallpaper-only interval, closing regression.
PERFORMANCE_RESULT=Ideal cadence quantization bound only: mean next-vsync wait 8.333ms@60 -> 4.167ms@120 (4.167ms gain); P95 15.833 -> 7.917ms (7.917ms gain). Incremental, not the >=50% core solution.
REGRESSION_RESULT=No production source mutation. Design boundary is Gen5 opening host only; Gen4 close/panel authority unchanged.
CONTRADICTIONS=Lane D became multi-claimed after this session started. Manager at 07:40:43Z split ownership: rnd-v69-hz09=current-main API/Kotlin touchpoints, rnd-gen5-120hz-97fe582d6615=cadence proof model, this agent=lifecycle/rejection/fallback + field matrix. This handoff is intentionally narrowed and cross-references peers rather than claiming whole Lane D.
RESIDUAL_RISKS=Samsung may ignore vote; seamless transition may still drop a frame; thermal/power policy may downshift; final Gen5 host topology may differ; app-visible cadence is not proof of physical scanout.
FOLD7_VALIDATION_REQUIRED=Yes. Verify supported/alternative modes, request event, Display.mode rate, >=20 FrameTimeline expected-present intervals, misses/deadlines, exact attempt IDs and clear reason. Then rapid close-reopen and 100+ 30-70 oscillation cycles.
INTEGRATION_TOUCHPOINTS=Gen5 opening visual host; FoldSurface/WindowManager params if View-backed; owned SurfaceControl if future host exposes one; FoldOverlayService display callbacks for observation only; DuoDiagnostics for telemetry.
ROLLBACK_FALLBACK=Feature gate disables refresh lease; virtual hinge continues on actual vsync. Rejected 120 automatically runs at actual lower cadence; no restart.
CHEAPEST_NEXT_DECISIVE_TEST=One Fold7 normal opening with request enabled and >=20 expected-present intervals, followed by rapid close->reopen proving stale cleanup cannot revoke new attempt.
MANAGER_QUESTIONS=Please merge this lifecycle/fallback contract and field matrix with the assigned API-touchpoint and cadence-proof peer outputs; require current-owner-only cleanup and actual FrameTimeline pacing in the combined Lane D disposition.

English summary: 120Hz is safe as an opening-only preference, not a guarantee. The important integration requirement is lifecycle fencing: request once before first visible frame, measure actual cadence, tolerate 60Hz/downshift without retrying, and ensure old-attempt cleanup cannot clear a newer opening. The pure model/fuzz suite passes; physical Fold7 proof remains required.
